notes.title: Becalm 1.3 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hey All! Hope the sailing adventure has been serendipitous, it's the onset of Fall/Spring and the 1.3 update to Becalm is here! Which brings the following improvements:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [h1]Surround - 3D Positional Sound [/h1] The entire soundtrack was carefully remastered and separated into individual audio sources that surround the player, perfectly emulating the calm sea vibes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34101866/5d9b97a102e51070e6bf694853b304f033b9b6f1.png[/img]

[*] [h1]Controller Support[/h1] You can now use Becalm on the Big Screen at ease, the entire experience can be controlled by Xbox or Playstation controllers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34101866/dd780937ceb9c95737aadc49e7f75aebf0bab85b.png[/img]

[*] [h1]Options Menu[/h1] Control the Sound volume, change the resolution, graphics quality and windowed mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34101866/cc84e42e45e2fbd33bb30306eca737b8bbd9f76b.gif[/img]

[*] [h1]And many performance improvements![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34101866/37b85bf14421d8e58ead2760e138c988699ac614.gif[/img]
[/list]



[h1]Enjoy this season of change and let me know below in the comments how the patch is working :)[/h1]

Best!
-Colorfiction


[b]A very special thanks to Eric Lorenz for doing such an amazing work remastering the audio and making this surround sound edition possible![/b]


[i]Full Patch Notes, Becalm v1.3:
[list]
[*] Added Options menu with resolution change dialog, volume slider, graphics quality options.
[*] Added Full controller support and navigation.
[*] Enabled Vsync.
[*] Restructuring of entire audio backend and remastering of soundtrack for positional audio update.
[*] Optimized Day - Night cycle, performance, and post processing on 'Beach' biome.
[*] Added moving volumetric fog to 'Bamboo' biome.
[*] Hundreds of quality of life changes.
[/list][/i]

Ode to a Moon is a first person thriller currently in development. As photo-journalist for a popular tabloid, you’re tasked with documenting a historic fall festival in a far away rural town during a centennial lunar eclipse. Camera in hand you set off to that romantic hamlet only to discover the macabre fallout of a town's descent into madness. It was inspired by real events and the belief that truth is stranger than fiction.

[list]
[*] Myst meets Silent Hill while on a stroll trough Tarkovsky’s Zone.
[*] A horror game without monsters or enacted violence. So no jumpscares in the traditional sense.
[*] First Person exploration mechanics with point and click adventure elements.
[*] Multiple endings = replayability!
[/list]
